title: Salty Glass Cottage Vacation Rental
meta_description: Salty Glass Cottage is a 1.00 bedroom, 1.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to Salty Glass, a beautifully renovated Gulf-front cottage in the heart of Seaside. This perfect, peaceful coastal escape, is a charming retreat that combines timeless style with modern comfort. Just steps from the beach and Seaside’s Central Square, guests can enjoy breathtaking Gulf views, a private jacuzzi, and relaxing outdoor spaces that capture the essence of a romantic 30A getaway.Property Highlights Gulf Views Steps From the Beach Two Adult Bikes Included with Rental Outdoor Jacuzzi Charcoal Grill Washer and Dryer Designated Parking Spot for 1 Vehicle Access to Three Community Pools, Tennis Center (Additional Fee), and Fitness Center Close to Seaside’s Central Square and WaterColor Shopping and Dining Perfect for Romantic Getaways (Guests Must Be 25+) 4-Minute Walk to Seaside Central Square Experience the Home Aligning perfectly with Seaside’s iconic coastal charm, Salty Glass offers a serene blend of classic “Old Florida” character and modern comfort. Completely renovated, the cottage features a soothing palette of natural tones accented by warm wood floors, beamed ceilings, and elegant whitewashed walls. Expansive windows frame stunning Gulf views and fill the space with natural light. On the main level, guests will find a cozy king bedroom with a flat-screen TV, private bathroom with marble walk-in shower, and direct access to a screened porch. This peaceful outdoor space features a private jacuzzi tub and rocking chairs, surrounded by privacy curtains for an intimate retreat. Upstairs, panoramic Gulf views greet you in the open living area, where designer furnishings, a queen sleeper sofa, and a fully equipped galley kitchen create a comfortable and stylish setting. The kitchen includes a compact refrigerator, stovetop, microwave, dishwasher, and freestanding ice maker. French doors open to a covered balcony with a porch swing and private dining area, perfect for coffee at sunrise or cocktails at sunset. Guests enjoy access to three community pools, a fitness center, croquet court, and tennis courts. Two adult bikes are provided for exploring Seaside’s charming streets, boutique shops, and dining just a short ride or walk away. Whether celebrating a honeymoon, anniversary, or peaceful coastal getaway, Salty Glass offers the perfect setting for relaxation and connection along 30A.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Washer and Dryer Private Screened Porch with Jacuzzi Tub Second Floor Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa (Sleeps 2) Kitchen with Compact Refrigerator, Microwave Oven, Dishwasher, Freestanding Ice Maker, and Stovetop Private Covered Balcony with Beach Views Life in Seaside Located in Seaside’s most desirable Gulf-front area, Salty Glass offers unmatched proximity to the beach and the charming town center. Guests can stroll or bike to boutique shopping, casual and fine dining, and local entertainment within minutes. With sweeping Gulf views and classic Seaside architecture, this cottage embodies the ultimate 30A coastal experience.
